TeamSnap Surpasses $20 Million Given Back to Youth Sports Through Brand-Sponsored Programs

paragraphs: TeamSnap sells software for running youth sports clubs and leagues. It also makes an app for the people on the ground, including coaches, team managers, and parents.

The organization platform bundles registration, payments, rosters, and schedules in one place. The app side carries drills, practice plans, schedules, chats, live streaming, and highlights. A brand solutions business connects sponsors to youth sports, and the company says brands have put more than $19 million into sponsorships through it.

The company says more than 30 million parents, players and coaches and over 19,000 sports organizations use the platform. It describes more than 15 years working on youth sports technology. Its own timeline records a $25M Series C round from Foundry Group and Fairfax Holdings. The same timeline lists the acquisition of LeagueSide, which became the basis of the brand solutions offering.
